question: The term ‘Follow – On’ is used in which of the following games/sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term** ‘Follow – On’ **is used in** cricket.**
 
• A team who **batted second in **the sport of cricket but scored significantly **fewer runs** than the team that** bat first** can be obliged to** follow-on,** or to play their **second innings **right after their first.
 
• The **side that batted first** may impose the follow-on.
 
• By** speeding up the second innings** of the second team, it aims to lower the** likelihood of a drawn outcome.**
 
• Only in the** types of cricket **where each team often bats twice—most notably **domestic first-class cricket** and** international Test cricket—**does the follow-on occur.
 
• **Boundary, LBW, Beamer, Appeal, Bails, Dolly, Edge** etc. are other terms used in cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey:**

 
 
• **16-yard hit, Advancing, Back-line, Bully, Center pass , Clearing, Dangerous Play,** etc. are some of the terms used in the game of **hockey**. 
 
 
 
• **Badminton:**
 
 
• **The backcourt, Birdie, Carry, Center position, Cross-court, Drop shot, Flick, Forecourt**, etc. are some of the terms used in the game of **badminton**.
 
 
 
• **Football:**
 
 
• **Line of scrimmage, fumble, muff, huddle, blitz, sack, scramble, special teams, **etc. are some of the terms used in the game football.
